{{Quote|Hunter Malis, in the past few years you've become a notable hunter. Your reputation has steadily grown. In fact, you've become something of a celebrity, even beyond hunter circles. Yet, virtually nothing is known about your background or you motives. People want to know who you are and why you became a hunter. '''Rengor Vanth''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] who worked for the news agency [[Sektor 242 NewsLine]]. At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Vanth interviewed the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Malis]] about his profession. The pair met in a bar and Vanth had originally planned to record footage of their meeting on a [[Holocamera/Legends|holocamera]], but Malis requested that Vanth instead use a [[Holorecorder/Legends|holorecorder]] to obtain an audio-only recording of their encounter.<ref name="OSS" />
